selection_rule: Use LightGBM only if validation AP improves by >=0.02 absolute and recall at max 5% alert rate is not lower than logistic; otherwise logistic
importance_definition: Mean absolute raw-score contribution over the first 2,000 chronological test rows, grouped by source feature; not causal importance

demo_sample.origin: first 2000 chronological test rows; no score or label selection
